title: Qman DirectPath typed qualification measurement
description: Closed signed observation produced before QualificationSubjectManifest construction. It binds one measured qualification field to a pinned collector and immutable raw observation artifacts; copying a value from a proposed QualificationRecord is not a measurement.
x-qmanCollectionRule: The collector binary and tool manifest resolve at target commit C and their raw bytes match the declared hashes. Every evidenceBinding path resolves inside evidence commit E, raw bytes/length/media type are verified, and any non-null schemaRef/schemaSha256/valueProjection tuple is resolved against the pinned normative schema before measuredValue is derived. schemaRefOrNull, schemaSha256OrNull and valueProjectionOrNull are either all non-null or all null. At least one schema-validated raw projection MUST byte-equal the complete measuredValue, except pciIdentityMatch is deterministically reconstructed from the exact DeviceRecord immutableIdentity plus the fixed NONE errata profile; labels and all-null projection tuples are insufficient. For HOST_INVENTORY_RECORD, evidenceBinding.sha256 is the final signed JSON file's raw-byte hash, while inventorySnapshotDigestOrNull is its parsed internal HostSnapshot.contentHash and equals HostAuthority.currentSnapshotContentHash; these are separate hash domains and MUST NOT be substituted. DEVICE_INVENTORY_RECORD resolves the exact schema-valid DeviceRecord whose deviceUid/deviceRecordHash equal this measurement and whose hash is a member of that HostSnapshot; deviceTraits must be the exact /technicalTraits projection. The complete set of bindings is field-specific and independently sufficient: identity/traits require both the signed current HostSnapshot and that exact DeviceRecord; deviceArchetype requires a final schema-valid DeviceClassificationRecord for the same device whose signedAt/digest/signature are non-null, whose repository-signed current-pointer receipt and signed ClassificationContext byte-equal the exact taxonomy/current snapshot/device/time/signer tuple, whose prior DeviceTaxonomyDefinition recursively binds classifier source/build/runtime and exact path/symbol/blob/semantic/interface hashes, and whose classifier replay byte-equals the retained construction projection before final signing. It consumes neither QualificationRecord nor SupportedCatalog. Firmware/ROM require live option-ROM/VPD/firmware readback; runtime requires distinct measured kernel, QEMU and firmware binaries plus version/capability readback; providers require live IOMMU/interrupt/reset/backend readback; guest/workload require attested guest ABI/architecture/vCPU/memory/capabilities/driver identity and the signed WorkloadResult plus evaluator report; caseExecution requires the immutable scenario execution-core input. A value copied only from QualificationRecord or QualificationSubjectManifest is invalid.
x-qmanFreshnessRule: All measurements bind one qualificationRunId, hostId, hostEpoch, bootId, deviceUid and deviceRecordHash. Non-case measurements bind the current inventory snapshot; caseExecution uses the same run/host/epoch/boot/device tuple and its measuredValue is the independently reconstructed scenarioExecutionCoreDigest. observedAt MUST fall inside the signed QualificationRunManifest interval and no later than the consuming QualificationSubjectManifest. Host boot/epoch change, stale inventory, device substitution, missing raw artifact or collector mismatch invalidates the measurement.
x-qmanSignatureRule: Set measurementDigest and signature to null, encode the complete object with CANONICAL-JSON-V1, store SHA-256 in measurementDigest, and sign ASCII(QMAN-DIRECTPATH/QUALIFICATION-MEASUREMENT/V1) || 0x00 || those bytes. HOST_INVENTORY_EVIDENCE signs host, firmware, runtime, provider, guest and trait measurements; QUALIFICATION_ENGINEERING signs deviceArchetype classification; TEST_EVIDENCE signs caseExecution only. Resolve the exact role/key/history/rollback/freshness chain before accepting the record.
